item.tib: dbal chen drag po rngam pa'i thugs rgyud dmar chen drag po'i gtor zlog shog bkra'i g.yen sde gting zlog
item.coloph: g.yen sde gting zlog zhes bya ba/ slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi (kyis) shel brag pad+ma ris kyi phugs su mdzad// mkha' 'gro ma la gtad/ phyi rabs las ldan gshen la brgyud pa 'di/ dam nyams log lta can la ma shor cig sa ma ya/ rgyargyargya//
